name: tiacommander
description: MCP server for Siemens TIA Portal. AI-assisted PLC programming. 16 tools, 166 actions.
long_description: TiaCommander connects AI assistants to Siemens TIA Portal via the Openness API. Create, read, import, export, and compile PLC blocks (SCL, LAD, FBD, STL). Browse hardware, cross-references, tag tables, and libraries. Manage projects, sessions, and deployments. Tested with Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI.
